0.original: Having seen the district to her satisfaction, Wuk Lamat is ready to head to the meeting point.

26.original: Speak with the blue-scaled Hoobigo child and follow their lead while accompanied by Wuk Lamat.

27.original: Follow the blue-scaled Hoobigo child while accompanied by Wuk Lamat.

48.original: So, we're supposed to go to a place called True Vue, in the eastern sector. This conveyor ought to take us there.

49.original: You know, once you get used to it, they're actually kind of fun. Come on, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

50.original: This is the right place, you think?

51.original: I don't see the others, though...

52.original: Well, rather than sitting and waiting, we might as well explore a bit more.

54.original: A Mamool Ja child... What are they doing here?

55.original: You noticed too, right? The resemblance to Zoraal Ja.

56.original: The blue scales of a Boonewa with the features of a Hoobigo...

58.original: At any rate, it wouldn't do to leave such a small child on their own.

59.original: Come on, let's go after them!

60.original: I think they ran this way...

61.original: So this is True Vue. I'm not sure what I'm looking at, but it does seem lively!

62.original: That building's just about the only one that isn't lit up. Not open for business at the moment, I guess?

65.original: Listen, we don't mean you any harm. We just want to talk.

66.original: It's a bit odd, don't you think? They run off when we approach, only to suddenly reappear...

67.original: Could it be they want to take us somewhere?

68.original: Is that the way of it? You want us to follow you?

69.original: So it is! Alright, then, lead the way!

70.original: Let's see where they take us.

72.original: Once you choose to depart, Wuk Lamat will accompany you. The blue-scaled Hoobigo child will then begin moving towards the destination.

73.original: Make your way to the destination without falling behind.

74.original: If you leave Wuk Lamat behind for any reason, or lose sight of the blue-scaled Hoobigo child, you may try again by returning to the starting point.

80.original: Let's try not to lose sight of them this time!

81.original: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Wuk Lamat?

82.original: Hm? Alexandrian food not agreeing with your stomach? Alright, I'll let the little one know you need some time. We'll wait for you back where we started.

83.original: Wuk Lamat has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.

84.original: Damn it, we've lost them! Probably best to return to where we started...

85.original: Speak with the blue-scaled Hoobigo child in the recreation zone to try again.

87.original: Once you choose to depart, Wuk Lamat will accompany you. The blue-scaled Hoobigo child will then begin moving towards the destination.

88.original: Is this where you wanted to bring us?

89.original: What is this place? If you're meant to relax here, it isn't working for me...

91.original: So you're still not inclined to talk...

92.original: He'll only talk if he's completely comfortable with you.

94.original: After a fashion. But never mind that. How about something to wet your whistle?

95.original: Adorable as you are, it's on the house. I can recommend our special─Her Majesty. I'll prepare one without liquor for the boy, too.

96.original: Uh, thanks, but no thanks. We're supposed to meet a friend named Cahciua.

97.original: But we ran into the child on the way, and he led us here.

99.original: In that case, go and have a chat with big Tassos there. He'll show you to a fun place.

101.original: I don't think he's in a mood to talk, so he can tend the bar with me.

102.original: This has taken a turn for the strange, but you don't think we're walking into a trap, do you?

103.original: Damned if this doesn't have suspicious written all over it...

104.original: If you feel like that drink after all, just let me know.

106.original: You seem eager to go, but what about your friend there?

107.original: What is this “fun place” meant to be? Is Cahciua there?

108.original: Well, I suppose there's only one way to find out...
